text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Change in error from adding a time-of-year encoding, with hour and weekday always included. 13 primary substations, validation year 2024-07 to 2025-06, one XGBoost model per substation trained on ERA5 weather (ECMWF's estimate of past weather). Dot: estimate over three fitting seeds. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Rule: no change.'
text.tspan: Change in error from adding a time-of-year encoding, with hour and weekday always included. 13 primary substations,
validation year 2024-07 to 2025-06, one XGBoost model per substation trained on ERA5 weather (ECMWF's estimate of past
weather). Dot: estimate over three fitting seeds. Line: 95% interval from re-drawing whole months. Rule: no change.
